card.name: Figure numbers in injection instructions
card.fires_on: The digit in a figure number right after the word Figure, in a caption or step heading of injection or syringe instructions. It also fires on the second digit of two-digit figure numbers such as 12 or 13.

modes.label: Caption digit
modes.description: A digit after the word Figure that starts a caption or step title, followed by a colon.
modes.example: Figure <<6>>: Clean the top of the vial

modes.label: Second digit of figure number
modes.description: The last digit of a two-digit figure number in a step heading.
modes.example: Figure 1<<2>>: Proper appearance of implant after initial filling

card.plain: It marks the number in a figure label inside step-by-step instructions for giving an injection.
